Integer and Complex Limiter.Description: Measures the time during which Integer and Complex work is attemped to execute as a percentage of peak Integer and Complex performance. A value of 100% indicates Integer and Complex execution pipeline has reached full capacity and cannot process more Integer and Complex instructions in parallel

Integer and Conditional Limiter.Description: Measures the time during which Integer and Conditional work is executed as a percentage of peak Integer and Conditional performance. Integer and Conditional Limiter.Name: Integer and Conditional Limiter
Integer and Conditional Limiter.Value: 0.55% Percentage of Peak Integer and Conditional Performance

Last Level Cache Limiter.Description: Measures the time during which GPU’s last level cache is attempting to service read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance
Last Level Cache Limiter.Name: Last Level Cache Limiter

Last Level Cache Utilization.Description: Measures the time during which GPU’s last level cache serviced read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance
Last Level Cache Utilization.Name: Last Level Cache Utilization

GPU Read Bandwidth.Description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read by the GPU from a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory)
